plan.summary: This 4-week block starts a 12-week off-camp boxing strength and power build with extra conditioning support. Week 1 establishes training baselines with a simple squat assessment so future loading can be adjusted cleanly, and the main training work begins in Week 2. With only 1 S&C session per week and minimal home equipment, the session stays focused: explosive work first, then main strength, then practical accessories and short conditioning.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build general lower-body power, squat strength, trunk stability, and basic conditioning without creating unnecessary fatigue.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress strength and power steadily while keeping the single weekly session crisp and recoverable around boxing practice.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Shift more toward fast force and sharp output while maintaining enough strength to support punching speed and durability.
